description.p: Subordinate is a cross-platform video editor built around a small Rust core: exact rational timeline math, an undoable command for every mutation, and a local Command API so agents and scripts drive the same edits a person does from the timeline.
Media decode, encode and muxing run on GStreamer, which this package bundles together with the hardware plugins, so no separate codec install is needed.
Export quality and chroma fixes, progress-aware encoder timeouts, explicit audio-stream selection, and export, probe, proxy and frame services in the running editor Command API.
Live preview: the viewer shows decoded video while scrubbing and playing, with 4K scrub above 45 fps on hardware decoders; the MCP bridge ships inside every package.
The editor now serves the Command API on its local socket, so the MCP bridge and other agents drive the running window and their edits appear live.
Import and relink from the media bin now run as jobs in the app; the AppImage gains the gst-discoverer tool.
